changes: Separated inventory-completeness critic dispatch and signed reviewer-run provenance from default topology certification. Enforced signed terminal read evidence at the PASS producer and inventory consumer, included critic discoveries in the exact Finding aggregate, corrected the English implementation audit, and hardened the validation heartbeat fixture readiness and cleanup witness without changing production deadlines. Corrected the test-only semantic mutation witnesses to strip the inherited signature before re-signing and prove exact semantic refusal after valid-signature admission; retained the restored positive control and corrected prior audit overclaims. Reconciled the bounded inventory-critic prompt approval baseline and integrated current main heartbeat safeguards.
usage: Use the worktree-local CLI to dispatch proof-or-stop-review-topology-critic with reviewPurpose=inventory-completeness and the current inventoryEpochId. The independent reviewer starts the matching signed run, records complete terminal read evidence and exact Finding dispositions; the owner finalizes the unchanged complete inventory before certification.
expectedOutcome: A real independent reviewer can complete inventory review under ordinary Harmonynet Git attribution, while missing or stale purpose/read bindings remain refusals and inventory receipts grant no topology or TEST/DONE authority.
actualTranscript: Current canonical intent refresh 8cafbfb reports eight mechanical PASS receipts. Final ordinary reviewers recorded concept RR-053/RP-040, coverage RR-054/RP-041, quality RR-055/RP-043, and real Agy docs RR-056/RP-042. Official DONE-required evidence ca6004bd21 reports build PASS and root full suite 65/65 PASS with zero retries. Canonical routine validation d45ef5f421 reports complete PASS for all 133 commands with zero required or optional failures. The PRE_CERT completeness receipt RIE-008:RCP-001 admitted CW-004 but is not discovery-saturation, topology, host, TEST or DONE authority. Actual Codex and Agy each completed the three post-f005 rounds; canonical review_escalation_status reports three valid two-host rounds with no invalid rounds. TEST admitted in 747a03f; its canonical validate reuses current PASS with commandExecutions=0 and 8/8 coverage. The fresh live transcript executes review-inventory-epoch-smoke.js with exit0 and records signed-read, exact-aggregate and valid-signature semantic-refusal PASS controls; replay metrics are simulated, not production throughput. Final DONE/local-main integration is not inferred from these observations.
outcomeDiff: The inventory-purpose implementation matches its bounded acceptance. The live transcript is an executed epoch regression suite, not a production rollout; public-handler coverage and independent review are separate evidence. Dependent Story completion is not claimed.
limitations: Inventory completeness does not certify topology, independent hosts or dependent Story completion. The configured pre-review topology profile remains observe/inconclusive; the rollout PASS is a synthetic fixture cohort. Historical missing read logs and unavailable old CAS bytes are not reconstructed. Parent process closure does not prove descendant cleanup; uncertain cleanup retains the disposable fixture.
pitfalls: Final inventory receipts consumed by DEV cannot admit certification, so complete repairs before final REVIEW and consume only through certification_window_begin. Use the current worktree-local CLI and independent reviewer environment; an earlier Agy coverage PASS with no readLog was preserved and excluded, then replaced by real native evidence. Whole validation must run standalone to avoid story_advance's shorter watchdog; refresh only materially stale intent evidence before final reviewer terminals. The heartbeat RED used a real six-second delayed child, and GREEN separately proved terminal diagnostics and close-before-delete behavior. During TEST, direct validate initially mismatched two watchdog environment inputs and then shadow mode launched the full oracle; the eventual official dynamicMode=off call reused the exact full PASS. A concurrent dispatch appended process metadata and a restarted run stopped at a gitIndex content-digest preflight; preserve those events and serialize evidence writes. A REVIEW-only inventory status capture failed in TEST, and the full public-handler capture exceeded its fixed 60-second ceiling; those failed transcripts remain in Git history. The successful current capture executes the bounded epoch suite and does not relabel those failures as passes. macOS power logs independently record a 925-second sleep during an earlier abnormal elapsed-time timeout. The original re-signed semantic-mutation tests inherited _hash and could fail signature verification before testing semantic guards. RED e13ea60b84 proved this premise failure; GREEN 6f45dfd032 supplies unsigned signing payloads while retaining valid-signature prerequisites, exact refusal assertions and the restored positive. Audit d66977d67f corrects the historical overclaim without implying a demonstrated production bypass. Old source-bound validation and host receipts remain historical and were not manually relabeled fresh. Resource contention can delay short host submissions behind another Story's heavy certification; preserve the original queued submissions and coordinate merge ordering rather than bypass capacity.
